responsibility: This definition module declares the DynamicStrings-based wrapper around selected FIO file-opening and line/string I/O operations. It belongs to the gm2 file I/O convenience layer and exports String-oriented Exists, OpenToRead, OpenToWrite, OpenForRandom, WriteS, and ReadS procedures that adapt the core File abstraction for callers using DynamicStrings.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public API declaration for the SFIO pair: it exports the String-oriented file-opening and line/string I/O procedures, while SFIO.mod contains the concrete FIO calls and DynamicStrings adaptation that implement them.
